items.text:
I just wanted to give Dinner Date a negative review, but the more I wrote, the more I realized, I should actually make a positive one. So, first things first: I actually enjoyed Dinner Date. Finally I can be lonesome, even in the virtual world! :)

The game, obviously doesn't come with its shortcomings-"short" being the keyword here. Like the description says, it is basically a 25 minute-very well recorded-narration on the life of Julian Luxemburg, who is, sort of, your avatar in this game, except he isn't but his subconsciousness is. This game is an experiment, how much elements of interactive story telling you can take away from it to still be interactive. And it actually left an impression on me. Not the interactive part, but the story, I could relate with the poor guy in a way too good way. The music is produced well and fits the mood perfectly.

On the graphical side, however, a lot more could have been possible. I am actually not sure, whether the author wanted it to be sort of realistic or more in a comic look.  If the game shone on this side, I would not hesitate to recommend it for full price, however, you will probably want to look when it is available for a reduced price. I believe, experiments, such as this, should be supported and as such  it is okay for this game to be free. And the author probably still needs to fully pay the voice actor and musician, so...

In the end, I imagine, this is one of the first games, where Steam refunds will be exploited, as there is practically no replay value. (I did replay it and enjoyed it a second time, but there was a long time in between.) So please, don't be a jerk and keep the game, if you appreciated it in any way-even if it just got you the realization, that you don't like this sort of games. :)
items.text_zh:
我本来只想给 Dinner Date 写个差评，但我写得越多，就越意识到，我其实应该写个好评。那么，先说第一点：我其实挺喜欢 Dinner Date 的。终于，我可以在虚拟世界里也孤身一人了！:)

这款游戏显然也有它的缺点——“短”是这里的关键词。就像描述里说的，它基本上就是一段25分钟、录制得非常出色的旁白，讲述朱利安·卢森堡的生活，他算是你在游戏里的化身，只不过不是他本人，而是他的潜意识。这款游戏是一个实验，看看你能从互动式叙事中拿掉多少元素，却仍然让它保持互动性。而它确实给我留下了印象。不是互动那部分，而是故事，我以一种好得过头的方式与这个可怜的家伙产生了共鸣。音乐制作精良，完美契合氛围。

然而在画面方面，本可以做得更多。我其实不确定作者是想让它有点写实，还是更偏向漫画风格。如果游戏在这方面也很出色，我会毫不犹豫地推荐全价购买，不过，你大概会想等它打折时再入手。我相信像这样的实验应该得到支持，因此这款游戏免费是可以的。而且作者大概还得全额支付配音演员和音乐人的费用，所以……

最后，我想这会是首批被利用 Steam 退款机制的游戏之一，因为它实际上几乎没有重玩价值。（我确实重玩了一遍，第二次也很享受，但中间隔了很长时间。）所以拜托，别当混蛋，如果你以任何方式欣赏过这款游戏，就把它留着吧——哪怕它只是让你意识到，你不喜欢这类游戏。:)
